summary: A task that finds a lane to the coordinating thread full (net.rs ConnCore::push_incoming_batch, ConnCore::flush_held_incoming, ConnCore::flush_reports; Link::owe / Link::consumed; record 0046): try, mark `owed`, try again; the consumer that makes room swaps the mark and notifies. A held packet has no bound: it is delivered once the core takes values, with no tick, or its task is cancelled. A held receipt is published or ends the task with its queue-full code after RESULT_WAIT, by the tick. The three lanes of the default single-owner runtime. With --delivery-shards K >= 1 the acknowledgements and the write receipts steered to a shard take another path (ShardInbox, ShardAckBudget), which is not modelled.
not_replayed: The counterexample of mut-single-attempt (the consumer empties the lane between the first attempt and the mark) needs a chosen schedule of the core and reactor threads; no deterministic test replays it, and the 5 ms tick hides it from a timing test (mut-single-attempt-ticked passes). No test lets a receipt wait for RESULT_WAIT (reach-queue-full-end). input_saturation_is_backpressure_and_loses_no_packet takes its packets one at a time through the test-only lane handle, not through the borrowed batch of the runtime; a_borrowed_ingress_batch_keeps_capacity_for_its_unconsumed_suffix is the deterministic test of that batch.
